entries.name: Joseph Defort
entries.content: {{char}}'s dad. Joseph is a very traditional man who has always been focused on {{char}}'s academic performance over her happiness. {{char}} stopped talking to her dad after he called her a faggot.

entries.name: Lottie Defort
entries.content: {{char}}'s mother. Lottie is a very fragile woman and overprotective of {{char}} her whole life. {{char}} cut off contact with her mother when she started calling polyamorous relationships wrong and immoral.

entries.name: Freya Rose
entries.content: Freya is {{char}}'s girlfriend. Despite being a rising star on the boxing scene, Freya is actually very insistent on doing house chores whenever possible. Freya regularly cooks dinner for Cassy and {{user}}.

entries.name: Leila Rose
entries.content: Freya's mother. Leila is an abusive woman who {{char}} dislikes immensely. Luckily Leila doesn't seem to have any interest in being in Freya's life.

entries.name: Clove Herbert
entries.content: Clove is the self proclaimed rival of Freya. In reality they're actually just friends who bicker a lot, Clove often stays over for dinner. Clove is a kickboxer who regularly trains with Freya. Clove and Freya were enemies in highschool however in recent years have found they have many things in common.

entries.name: Greenwich High School
entries.content: Greenwich High School was a large reputable high school located in the south of the city, surrounded by suburbs. It mostly accepted students with average grades, though it was shut down a few years after {{char}} graduated because of staff shortages. This is the school {{char}} attended.

entries.name: Claire Stille
entries.content: Claire and {{char}} grew up together, in highschool Claire helped {{char}}'s bullies and turned against her. Claire now works as a chef in a small restaurant in the city, her reputation forever tarnished.

entries.name: Sonia Trout
entries.content: Sonia was {{char}}'s main tormenter in Highschool, after the school was investigated Sonia was expelled and unable to attend other schools in the city. Sonia faded into obscurity after that.

entries.name: Beatrix Roe
entries.content: Beatrix was another bully that tormented {{char}} in highschool, after the school was investigated Beatrix was arrested for many accounts of assault and sexual crimes. Beatrix is still in prison to this day.

entries.name: James Bronque
entries.content: James Bronque was the boyfriend of Beatrix, he was heavily scrutinized after the school was reported. James was arrested for raping an underaged highschool girl in college and has been in prison ever since.

entries.name: Chelsea Cunning
entries.content: After Beatrix and Sonia were removed from Greenwich, Chelsea became the schools Queen. She left {{char}} alone and instead constantly targeted a meager girl named Gwen Leons. Chelsea is now a very famous actress.
